uncited: Builds a retrieval database using raw image volumes and SOI labels instead of expert-designed TFs.
It is chosen to rapidly retrieve and adapt existing visualizations based on structural similarity, requiring less effort than manual TF collection.
Assigns optical properties based on predicted ROI-wise class probabilities via a weighted sum, incorporating voxel intensity into TF design.
It is chosen to allow intuitive assignment of optical properties based on confidence levels, though it may suppress fine details due to intensity variation within ROIs.
